title: Tower preservation condition
statement:
Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be a cartesian square
[def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$,
$g:Y'\to Y$ and $g':X'\to X$. Fix the adic coefficient datum
$A,I,P_n=A/I^n,A_T$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] on its four
schemes. All strict towers below are towers of modules over the completed
coefficient sheaf $A_T$, in the category $\operatorname{Tow}_A(T)$ of that
datum.

Use the total derived functors of levelwise module direct image
[prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits] and levelwise module pullback along
the completed coefficient structure maps [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]:
$$
\begin{aligned}
 Rf_*^{\operatorname{Tow}} &: D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(X))\longrightarrow D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(Y)),\\
 Rf'_*^{\operatorname{Tow}} &: D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(X'))\longrightarrow D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(Y')),\\
 Lg^*_{\operatorname{Tow}} &: D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(Y))\longrightarrow D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(Y')),\\
 Lg'^*_{\operatorname{Tow}} &: D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(X))\longrightarrow D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(X')).
\end{aligned}
$$
These pullback functors are taken before the derived inverse limit in the
completed-pullback definition.

Write $\mathrm{TOW}(\square)$ if each of these four functors carries every
uniformly bounded constructible adic tower on its source to a tower of the
same kind on its target, in the full sense of
[def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Precisely, for every input adic
tower with the level coefficient structures, normalization maps and uniform
local models specified there, the output object in
$D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(T))$ must admit all the data required by that
definition: level objects over $(P_n)_T$ whose restrictions of scalars are
its evaluations, normalization isomorphisms inducing its transition maps
and satisfying the quotient cocycle, and a common finite stratification
with bounded adic-lisse finite-type local complexes and reduction
isomorphisms compatible with normalization. The local models must be
compatible with the amplitude containments of
[def-weil-pbc-finite-level-amplification], using its finite-level operations
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] on the supplied quotient-coefficient
level objects.

The level objects over $(P_n)_T$ are part of the adic-tower data, not an
identification of an arbitrary $A_T$-module evaluation with a quotient-
coefficient complex. No formula identifying the evaluation of completed-
coefficient tower pullback with $Lg_n^*$ on arbitrary towers is included
in this predicate. The evaluation comparison in
[def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] applies to the reduction tower $K_\bullet$
of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. The preservation quantifier above
ranges over every uniformly bounded constructible adic tower, not only
these reduction towers.

note:
*Source note:* no Stacks Project entry states this predicate: that direct
images and pullbacks of a bounded constructible tower remain one is the
tower-level form of the constructibility and amplitude conditions of Lemma
59.92.2 ([Tag 095U](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/095U)), Theorem
63.14.5 ([Tag 0GL0](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0GL0)), Definition
61.29.1 ([Tag 09C1](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C1)) and
Proposition 61.29.7 ([Tag 09C7](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C7)),
which are stated for a single complex on a Noetherian scheme; the closest
tower-level entry is Lemma 61.29.2 ([Tag
09C2](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C2)), which bounds the
reduction tower of one constructible object but does not carry it through a
functor. The blueprint adds the preservation predicate
$\mathrm{TOW}(\square)$ together with the local finite-locally-constant
models.

split_report.summary: Repaired both returned faults: stated all four completed-coefficient tower functors with their actual arrow-specific domains, and removed the unjustified identification of arbitrary tower evaluations with finite-coefficient complexes. Preservation still quantifies over every uniformly bounded constructible adic tower and requires the full quotient-coefficient, normalization, local-model and amplitude data. The completed-pullback finite-level comparison is explicitly limited to reduction towers as its dependency states. No new nodes, no preservation theorem asserted, no target changed.
split_report.blueprint: Definition paragraph of def-weil-pbc-tower-preservation: its levelwise tower functors, every uniformly bounded constructible tower, and local models compatible with amplitude containments; there is no proof paragraph to realize.
